formulas.definitions: eta = alpha(1-2nu)/(2(1-nu)); beta = (nu_u-nu)/(alpha(1-2nu)); gamma = (nu_u-nu)/(1-nu) = 2 beta eta; tau = c t/L^2; loading magnitude sigma (loading 1) or p (loading 2)
formulas.K1_0: K1(0+) = a(gamma) sigma sqrt(pi L), gamma=(nu_u-nu)/(1-nu). a = drained-tip/undrained-far-field factor of the self-similar crack-tip problem; Laplace-domain J-integral: (1-nu) a^2 = (1-nu_u) - (fluid tip-flux term) < (1-nu_u); weak coupling a = 1 - 3 gamma/4 + O(gamma^2) [a^2 = (1-gamma)(1-gamma/2) + O(gamma^2)]; numerical fit a = 1 - 0.75 gamma - 0.0634 gamma^2 - 0.0582 gamma^3; a(0.25) = 0.80759. (Instantaneous undrained value at t = 0 exactly: sigma sqrt(pi L).)
formulas.V1_short_coeff: V1 = pi(1-nu_u) sigma L^2/G + A (sigma L^2/G) sqrt(c t/L^2) + O(t^(3/4)); A = (16/sqrt(pi)) gamma (1-nu_u) [drained face layers, exact] + A_tip [crack-tip regions]; A_tip = (2/sqrt(pi))(1-nu_u) chat(gamma), chat = 2 pi gamma + 0.434 gamma^2 + 0.37 gamma^3 (numerical; first order exact); first-order closed form A = 4(4+pi)(nu_u-nu)(1-nu_u)/(sqrt(pi)(1-nu))
formulas.p_faces_0: p(0+) next to faces = 2(nu_u-nu) sigma/(alpha(1-2nu)) = 2 B (1+nu_u) sigma/3
formulas.K2_0: K2(0+) = 0; K2 ~ -C (c t/L^2)^(1/4) p sqrt(pi L) at small t (C = 0.2599 for the given data)
formulas.K2_inf: K2(inf) = -eta p sqrt(pi L) = -alpha(1-2nu) p sqrt(pi L)/(2(1-nu)); approach K2 ~ -eta[1 - 1/(ln(16 c t/L^2) - gamma_E)]
formulas.V2_inf: V2(inf) = -pi eta (1-nu) p L^2/G = -pi alpha (1-2nu) p L^2/(2G)

supplementary.uncertainty: a = 0.807593 +/- 5e-6; A = 2.4401 +/- 0.0003 (numerical extrapolation s -> infinity, data to s = 1e7)
